numeric_mode_note: Public translation is Pythonic. Exact REAL restrictions below preserve the legacy contract for a future strict milestone; see ../numeric-modes.md.
boundary: Internal unsized anonymous outer ARRAY results with supported scalar, explicitly bounded STRING, record, exact-width joint or prior named fixed ARRAY elements, one outer dimension and at most three logical dimensions. Independent recursively checked copies and direct assignment only; all scalar leaves known/initialized. Exact STRING element capacities retained and checked without result truncation. Named outer results, flat multidimensional result sources/declarations, unspecified STRING capacities, direct STRING returns and whole ARRAY value arguments remain blocked. Recursive checked offline policy; no native layout, stack cost, ABI, partial-copy or controller-runtime equivalence claim.

rules.documented: ARRAY is a function return type. Result declarations omit size so returned length can vary. A returned array must match the destination size and data type.
rules.implemented: Internal unsized ARRAY OF INTEGER/BOOLEAN/REAL/BYTE/SHORT, prior named STRUCTURE, CONFIG/VECTOR/XYZWPR/XYZWPREXT/POSITION or exact-width JOINTPOS1..9. Unsuffixed JOINTPOS means nine axes. Anonymous concrete source storage with one outer dimension retains actual length and exact resolved element type. Prior named fixed ARRAY elements are also supported with one outer dimension and at most three logical dimensions; every inner component retains its exact name and shape. Explicitly bounded ARRAY OF STRING[capacity] results and named ARRAY components with bounded STRING terminals retain exact capacities in 1..254.
rules.restriction: No named outer ARRAY result types/storage, flat multidimensional result sources/declarations, unspecified STRING result-element capacities, fixed/wildcard result sizes, external routines or inferred storage. Prior element-type definitions are required. A zero-parameter function name or explicit call can supply the complete assignment RHS.
rules.tests: tests/test_array_results.py: all three scalar types, differing lengths, global/local/formal/field storage, external shapes, recursion, FOR, SELECT and labels; tests/test_narrow_array_results.py: narrow endpoints, formals, fields, shapes and recursion; tests/test_aggregate_array_results.py: record/joint element declarations, ownership and restrictions

rules.documented: An ARRAY-valued function result can be used only in a direct assignment; it cannot be an argument to another routine. The manual shows staging into an array before passing it.
rules.implemented: Only a complete function call (bare zero-parameter name or explicit call) as assignment RHS enables ARRAY results. Ordinary destination arrays, supported fields and reference formals use existing exact concrete type/length checks. Staged arrays can then pass by reference.
rules.restriction: Grouped result calls, operator/condition/selector/built-in arguments, routine arguments and direct RETURN forwarding fail with E_ARRAY_RESULT_CONTEXT or an earlier existing guard. Whole-array value arguments remain prohibited. Named destination identity is not erased and mismatched sizes/types are not coerced.
rules.tests: tests/test_array_results.py: context negatives, staging, generic destinations, nominal/length checks, preserved destination and indexed-target effects

rules.implemented: RETURN validates all recursive scalar leaves, nominal record identities, concrete nested shapes, STRING capacities, CONFIG contents and joint widths before copying. The copy completes before frame cleanup. All leaves must be initialized/known. The prototype bound is 32767 scalar leaves, including joint axes. Captured nested references survive in-place destination replacement.
rules.restriction: Full initialization is a conservative prototype restriction, not a native rule established here. Unknown data, malformed host storage and rounded/invalid numeric contents fail before any returned value or assignment is exposed. Existing side effects are retained; errors/ABORT/depth failures unwind frames.
rules.tests: tests/test_array_results.py: independence, source/destination aliasing, stable element references, full-init/type/range/shape guards, maximum length, errors/ABORT/depth cleanup

rules.documented: ARRAY results omit size and keep element data type. BYTE and SHORT may occur within arrays or structures. BYTE has values 0..255 and no uninitialized checking; SHORT stores -32768..32766 with 32767 denoting uninitialized. Out-of-range assignment is an execution error.
rules.implemented: Reuse checked array-result copies: known BYTE 0..255 and initialized SHORT -32768..32766 retain exact element type and concrete length. The SHORT marker, unknown initial BYTE contents and malformed host leaves fail before exposing a result or changing the destination. Earlier effects persist and frames unwind. Scalar narrow arguments to INTEGER/REAL remain independent promoted temporaries.
rules.restriction: Full known initialization is a conservative prototype guard, not a native BYTE or partial-copy claim. No whole-array element promotion, direct scalar BYTE/SHORT results, guessed BYTE defaults, BYTE initialization queries, native layout/ABI, native alarms or controller-runtime equivalence.
rules.tests: tests/test_narrow_array_results.py: 34 checks; all 256 BYTE values, SHORT bounds/marker, ownership, exact type/length, promotion, effects, cleanup and blocked contexts; examples/narrow_array_functions.kl

rules.feature: Record and joint ARRAY result elements
rules.documented: The ARRAY entry permits aggregate element types and requires the returned size/data type to match the destination. User-defined records retain type identity. JOINTPOS declares its axis width, defaulting to nine. The function rule requires unsized ARRAY results and direct assignment use.
rules.implemented: Prior named STRUCTURE, all five supported built-in data records and exact-width joints reuse recursive checked value copies. Nested arrays retain named identity and shape; STRING fields retain capacity. POSITION orientation children keep their read-only protection and start unknown unless explicit initialized host data is supplied. Exact joint copies need no conversion context; existing conversion procedures still require their explicit axis context.
rules.restriction: Full known initialization is a conservative prototype restriction. No source orientation acquisition/defaults, geometry/kinematics, cross-type/width coercion, native layout/ABI, alarms, partial-copy or controller execution equivalence is inferred. Whole ARRAY value arguments and direct result forwarding remain blocked.
rules.tests: tests/test_aggregate_array_results.py: 46 controls for recursive ownership, all built-in records and joint widths, exact nominal/width/shape checks, unknown/corrupt leaves, stable nested references, POSITION protection, errors and cleanup; examples/aggregate_array_functions.kl

rules.feature: Named ARRAY components in function results
rules.documented: ARRAY elements may be separately declared user-defined ARRAY types. Named subarray components support assignment/reference use and at most three total dimensions. ARRAY function results omit their outer size and require direct assignment to matching destination storage.
rules.implemented: Combine those rules in a conservative offline contract: ARRAY OF prior_named_array returns anonymous storage with one concrete outer dimension and exact fixed named inner components. Total logical rank is two or three. Supported terminal scalars including bounded STRINGs, records and exact-width joints reuse recursive checked copies; report element_spec retains every component and logical_rank reports the total.
rules.restriction: No flattening or reconstruction from flat multidimensional sources, erasure of named outer identity, inline anonymous nesting, unspecified STRING result-element capacities, partial/unknown leaves or whole ARRAY value arguments. A generic formal preserves actual outer identity, which is checked again at RETURN. STRUCTURE fields can retain supported STRING capacities. This composition has no fresh native compiler or controller evidence.
rules.tests: tests/test_named_component_array_results.py: 40 controls for two/three logical dimensions, component identity/shape, terminal types, independence, stable references, generic formals, external shapes, recursive staging, effects, corruption, ABORT and cleanup; examples/named_component_array_functions.kl

rules.documented: ARRAY results omit their outer size and require matching destination array size/data type. ARRAY elements may use data types other than PATH. STRING has an explicit physical capacity 1..254 and ordinary storage assignment truncates on the right. STRING reference parameters omit physical length and inherit caller storage. The STRING entry excludes direct STRING results.
rules.implemented: Compose those rules as a bounded offline contract: ARRAY OF STRING[constant_capacity] or prior named fixed ARRAY components with bounded STRING terminals. Return sources have one anonymous outer dimension and exact named inner components, total logical rank at most three. Generic ARRAY OF STRING source formals retain actual concrete capacity, checked against the fixed result capacity at runtime. Recursively copy initialized ASCII leaves, including empty strings, before local-frame cleanup. Never truncate a return to fit a different capacity, infer capacity or change the existing STRING value-temporary policy.
rules.restriction: This combined result syntax is an offline interpretation, not fresh native compiler or controller acceptance. Unspecified STRING result capacities and direct STRING results remain rejected. Unknown/uninitialized, non-ASCII or oversized corrupt host leaves fail before exposing a result or replacing the destination; earlier independent effects remain. Named outer identity, exact destination length/capacity, scalar-leaf limits and all existing context/effect/cleanup guards remain.
rules.tests: tests/test_string_array_results.py: 45 checks covering all 254 capacities at runtime, declaration endpoints/constants, generic formals, named rows/planes, stable captured references, ownership, staging, recursion, shape/capacity/type failures, corrupt leaves, earlier effects, ABORT and cleanup; examples/string_array_functions.kl
